name: tarn
description: Tarn — Intelligent Personal ATS & Job Application Tracker with Marker design system

scripts.setup: node -e "if (!require('fs').existsSync('.env')) require('fs').copyFileSync('.env.example', '.env'); if (!require('fs').existsSync('packages/database/.env')) require('fs').symlinkSync('../../.env', 'packages/database/.env')" && docker compose up -d --wait && pnpm db:migrate:deploy && pnpm db:seed
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && pnpm db:migrate:deploy && pnpm --parallel --filter "@tracker/*" dev
